title: Cancellation Requests, Mutual Release and Refunds — Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Article 18. Buyer cancellation and refunds.**

18.1 *Request and confirmation.* Every buyer cancellation of a Home Purchase Agreement starts as a cancellation request recorded with its basis and the date it was received, and takes effect only when the buyer confirms it.

18.2 *Mutual release.* A mutual release (basis mutual release, including a late rescission request or a late financing-denial request) refunds the initial earnest money, the additional deposit, the contingency deposit and the transferred reservation deposit, less the collection's mutual release fee. The fee is booked as a mutual release fee charge and collected by deduction from the refund. The lot premium deposit is forfeited with the reason cancellation non-refundable, unless the collection marks the lot premium deposit as refundable.

18.3 *No mutual release fee.* Rescission, financing denial, contingency and builder-delay cancellations carry no mutual release fee.

18.4 *Refund timing and form.* Refunds are issued within the collection's refund processing business days after the cancellation date, one refund entry per source payment and deposit component.

**Table to Article 18.**

| Cancellation basis | Mutual release fee |
|---|---|
| Mutual release (including a late rescission or late financing-denial request) | Charged, collected by deduction from the refund |
| Rescission | None |
| Financing denial | None |
| Contingency | None |
| Builder delay | None |

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** A buyer confirms a mutual release on an agreement holding initial earnest money of 6000.00, an additional deposit of 2000.00 and a lot premium deposit of 3000.00, in a collection with a 250.00 mutual release fee where the lot premium deposit is not refundable. The refundable components total 8000.00; the 250.00 mutual release fee is booked as a charge and deducted, so 7750.00 is refunded; the 3000.00 lot premium deposit is forfeited with reason cancellation non-refundable.
